sn1.81:1.1: Kesu-dha araṇā loke || kesaṃ vusiṭaṃ na nassati || ke-dha icchaṃ parijānanti || kesaṃ bhojisiyaṃ sadā || ||
sn1.81:2.1: kiṃsu mātā pitā bhātā || vandanti naṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ || kaṃsu idha jātihīnaṃ || abhivādenti khattiyā ti || ||
sn1.81:3.1: Samaṇīdha araṇā loke || samaṇānaṃ vusitaṃ na nassati || samaṇā icchaṃ parijānanti || samaṇānaṃ bhojisiyaṃ sadā || ||
sn1.81:4.1: Samaṇaṃ mātā pitā bhātā || vandanti naṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ || samaṇīdha jātihīnaṃ || abhivādenti khattiyā ti || || Chetvā-vaggo aṭṭhamo ||
sn1.81:5.0: Tass-uddānam Chetvā Rathaṃ ca Vittaṃ ca || Vuṭṭhi Bhītā Na-jīrati || Issaraṃ Kāmaṃ Pātheyyaṃ || Pajjoto Araṇena cā ti || || Devatā-Samyuttaṃ samattaṃ || || ******************************************** ___________________________________________
